name: WF9 – Détection de Signaux & Enrichissement Profil

parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.full_name, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.title, p.company, p.industry, p.linkedin_url, p.instagram_username, p.platform, p.profile_score, p.status, p.public_fact, p.last_signal_at FROM prospects p WHERE p.status NOT IN ('do_not_contact','unsubscribed','converted') AND p.profile_score >= 5 AND (p.last_signal_at IS NULL OR p.last_signal_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') ORDER BY p.profile_score DESC, p.last_signal_at ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 50

parameters.jsCode:
// ─── Sauvegarde signal + message généré ──────────────────────────
const msg = $input.item.json?.content?.[0]?.text || '';
const p = $('Détecteur de signaux').item.json;
const sig = p._signal;

return [{
  json: {
    prospect_id: p.id,
    signal_type: sig.type,
    signal_strength: sig.strength,
    signal_source: sig.source,
    signal_title: sig.title,
    signal_excerpt: sig.excerpt,
    signal_date: sig.signal_date,
    score_delta: sig.delta,
    generated_message: msg.trim(),
    full_name: p.full_name,
    platform: p.platform,
    current_status: p.status,
    new_score: Math.min(10, p.profile_score + sig.delta),
    insert_sql: `
      INSERT INTO prospect_signals
        (prospect_id, signal_type, signal_strength, signal_source, signal_title,
         signal_excerpt, signal_date, score_delta, generated_message, processed)
      VALUES
        (${p.id}, '${sig.type}', '${sig.strength}', '${sig.source}',
         '${sig.title.replace(/'/g,"''")}',
         '${sig.excerpt.replace(/'/g,"''")}',
         '${sig.signal_date}', ${sig.delta},
         '${msg.trim().replace(/'/g,"''")}', FALSE)
      RETURNING id`,
    update_sql: `
      UPDATE prospects
      SET profile_score = LEAST(10, profile_score + ${sig.delta}),
          last_signal_at = NOW(),
          signal_count = COALESCE(signal_count, 0) + 1,
          public_fact = '${sig.excerpt.replace(/'/g,"''").substring(0,200)}'
      WHERE id = ${p.id}`
  }
}];
